verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs explicitly promote OpenTelemetry as the standard instrumentation path, support native OTLP ingestion over gRPC/HTTP, and even provide a Collector-based path to convert legacy formats (OpenTracing/Zipkin/Jaeger) to OTLP — enabling instrument-once, backend-agnostic telemetry. This directly satisfies the SRE story of avoiding vendor lock-in via open standards. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of actually switching backends without re-instrumentation, and no explicit vendor statement about portability/lock-in avoidance beyond the standard OTel support.
